subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent model-facing append contract, or require a different API such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before closing this issue?
rationale: The failure is source-reproducible, but the fix changes a shared model-facing and extension-observable tool contract that automation should not finalize without maintainer API intent.

options.title: Accept append flag on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after review and conflict cleanup, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or shell-redirection workarounds, accepting that truncation risk remains for ordinary write calls.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after review and conflict cleanup, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shared agent-runtime API decision, and the strongest history signal points to steipete for the runtime/tool boundary.
